page.intro_en: The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) has released the category-wise list of selected candidates for the post of Assistant Commandant (GD) through the Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) for the vacancy year 2025. Candidates who appeared for the examination can check their roll number, force rank, and name in the official selection list.
